_id.description: MongoDB document identifier. Accepts ObjectId (driver default) or string (for deterministic ids if needed). Matches the bsonType of `products._id` for cross-collection consistency.

alt_text.description: Alternative text for accessibility (WCAG 2.1) and SEO. Required for images on the storefront UI but not enforced by this validator because some media kinds (e.g., `document`) may not need it. Application-layer Pydantic models in `../../src/` enforce presence for `kind=image`.

cdn_url.description: URL of the CDN-hosted asset (image, video, or document). Must be a non-empty HTTP(S) URL. The asset bytes themselves live on the CDN; this collection stores ONLY the metadata. The 2048-character upper bound matches common URL-length limits across CDNs and HTTP intermediaries. The pattern is intentionally lenient (no full RFC 3986 parse) — the application layer performs richer URL validation via Pydantic's `HttpUrl` type. Both `http://` and `https://` are permitted; production should use HTTPS (AAP R-24) but local dev against MinIO / fake CDNs may use HTTP.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the media reference was registered. Stored as MongoDB BSON date (millisecond precision). Immutable post-create.

height.description: Pixel height for image/video; absent for documents. Application validation enforces presence for `kind=image|video` once the asynchronous inspection job populates dimensions.

kind.description: Media classification driving rendering and storage behavior. 'image' = static image (jpg/png/webp); 'video' = video file (mp4/webm); 'document' = downloadable resource (pdf/spec sheet). These values match the application's `MediaKind` StrEnum in `../../src/domain/models.py` — kept in sync via code review per parent folder spec.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata bag for kind-specific attributes (e.g., mime_type, file_size_bytes, duration_seconds, codec, color_profile, transcoding_status, signed_url_expires_at). Application-layer Pydantic models constrain shape per kind. The lack of `properties` keys here is intentional (AAP R-7 — flexible schema); `additionalProperties: true` at the document root permits this bag to grow without validator churn.

mime_type.description: RFC 6838 media type (e.g., 'image/jpeg', 'video/mp4', 'application/pdf'). Optional; absent if not yet inspected by the upload pipeline. The pattern approximates the RFC 6838 grammar — strict enough to reject obvious garbage, lenient enough to accept vendor-prefixed types (e.g., 'application/vnd.api+json').

product_id.description: Reference to the owning product (`products._id`). Foreign-key-ish reference to a peer document in the same `product_db` (NOT cross-service per AAP R-6). Backed by the `idx_product_media__product_sort` compound index for fast media-listing queries. NOT nullable — every media document MUST belong to a product; orphan media is a bug.

sort_order.description: Display order within the product's media list. Lower values appear first. Capped at 100000 to bound list-merge cost; larger values are pathological for storefront UX and are rejected by the application's bulk-reorder API at the same threshold. Backed by the `idx_product_media__product_sort` compound index.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent update (e.g., when alt_text was changed or transcoding metadata was populated).

width.description: Pixel width for image/video; absent for documents. Application validation enforces presence for `kind=image|video` once the asynchronous inspection job populates dimensions.
